issue.title: Supernova's moveAfter() behaves differently than for scsynth

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issues that relate to unexpected/unwanted behavior. Don't use for PRs.

issue.body:
<!-- Please see CONTRIBUTING.md for guidelines. -->

## Environment

* SuperCollider version: 3.2.12
* Operating system: Ubuntu 22.04
* Other details (Qt version, audio driver, etc.): 

## Steps to reproduce

```supercollider
Server.supernova;
s = Server.default();
s.waitForBoot( SynthDef(\test, { Out.ar(10, SinOsc.ar())} ).add; );

g = Group();
h = Group(addAction: 'addToTail');

a = Synth(\test, target: g, addAction: 'addToTail');
b = Synth(\test, target: g, addAction: 'addToTail');
c = Synth(\test, target: g, addAction: 'addToTail');

s.queryAllNodes;
/*
NODE TREE Group 0
   0 group
      1 group
         1000 group
            1002 test
            1003 test
            1004 test
         1001 group
*/

a.moveToHead(h);
c.moveAfter(a);
s.queryAllNodes;

/*
NODE TREE Group 0
   0 group
      1 group
         1000 group
            1003 test
            1004 test
         1001 group
            1002 test
*/

a.moveToHead(g);
b.moveToHead(h);
a.moveToHead(h);
c.moveAfter(b);
s.queryAllNodes;
/*
NODE TREE Group 0
   0 group
      1 group
         1000 group
            1004 test
         1001 group
            1002 test
            1003 test
*/
c.moveAfter(a);
s.queryAllNodes;
/*
NODE TREE Group 0
   0 group
      1 group
         1000 group
         1001 group
            1002 test
            1004 test
            1003 test
*/
c.moveAfter(b);
s.queryAllNodes;
/*
NODE TREE Group 0
   0 group
      1 group
         1000 group
            1004 test
         1001 group
            1002 test
            1003 test
*/
s.freeAll;

```

## Expected vs. actual behavior

Except for the 1st and the 4th query listed above (out of 5), the listing given by `supernova` is different than what I'd expect from `moveAfter()` and different from the output given by `scsynth`.  I'd expect `supernova` to behave in the same way as `scsynth`:

```supercollider
Server.scsynth;
s = Server.default();
s.waitForBoot( SynthDef(\test, { Out.ar(10, SinOsc.ar())} ).add; );

g = Group();
h = Group(addAction: 'addToTail');

a = Synth(\test, target: g, addAction: 'addToTail');
b = Synth(\test, target: g, addAction: 'addToTail');
c = Synth(\test, target: g, addAction: 'addToTail');

s.queryAllNodes;
/*
NODE TREE Group 0
   1 group
      1000 group
         1002 test
         1003 test
         1004 test
      1001 group
*/

a.moveToHead(h);
c.moveAfter(a);
s.queryAllNodes;

/*
NODE TREE Group 0
   1 group
      1000 group
         1003 test
      1001 group
         1002 test
         1004 test
*/

a.moveToHead(g);
b.moveToHead(h);
a.moveToHead(h);
c.moveAfter(b);
s.queryAllNodes;
/*
NODE TREE Group 0
   1 group
      1000 group
      1001 group
         1002 test
         1003 test
         1004 test
*/
c.moveAfter(a);
s.queryAllNodes;
/*
NODE TREE Group 0
   1 group
      1000 group
      1001 group
         1002 test
         1004 test
         1003 test
*/
c.moveAfter(b);
s.queryAllNodes;
/*
NODE TREE Group 0
   1 group
      1000 group
      1001 group
         1002 test
         1003 test
         1004 test
*/
s.freeAll;
```


It is unclear to me whether already reported issues: #936 and #3100 are related to this one.
